newsitem.title: ITALY: Rome cabinet approves draft law on STET transfer.
newsitem.headline: Rome cabinet approves draft law on STET transfer.

text.p: The Italian cabinet approved a draft law on Wednesday to complete transfer of telecommunications giant STET from state holdings concern IRI to the Treasury.

The draft law aims to counter the effects of a government defeat last week, when the lower house of parliament voted against the transfer, which is necessary for STET's planned privatisation later this year.
